verdict.rationale: Entra ID ships its own background automation. Lifecycle Workflows contain processes that "run automatically against users as they move through their lifecycle", and SCIM-based automatic provisioning keeps users and groups synced into SaaS and on-prem apps without manual action. These automations are limited to identity-governance tasks, not general-purpose user-defined or agentic automations. missing for 10: general-purpose custom automation or agent workflows, documentation of triggers, scheduling and configuration depth, independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous operation.
